pattern.description: Zero a 3-dword IPC message header in RAM, store handler/callback address in last dword, then write to doorbell MMIO to dispatch
pattern.template_c: void message_dispatch_n(void) { ((volatile uint32_t *)0x2007fef0)[0] = 0; ((volatile uint32_t *)0x2007fef0)[1] = 0; ((volatile uint32_t *)0x2007fef0)[2] = 0; ((volatile uint32_t *)0x2007fef0)[3] = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)handler; *(volatile uint32_t *)DOORBELL_REG = TRIGGER_VAL; }
